title: The pup's first gray
logline: The pup's muzzle, close, seven, the first gray hairs in the black. The page counts them: four. The strip did this for the first dog in 2007; the private work does it without the caption.

panels.composition: Extreme close-up of a small dog's black muzzle with four gray hairs in it, the eye at the frame's edge, lamplight.
